value.rationale: The asymptotic Tjurina/Milnor ratio under repeated Thom–Sebastiani operations is a motivated structural invariant and gives a new sharp decay/equality dichotomy with explicit constants, rather than a routine parameter substitution or small finite count. It resolves every repetition count and, in plane curves, depends only on mu and tau. It may inform interpretation of analytic-versus-topological complexity as embedding dimension grows.
